4 افحج حَلُوبَتَهُ He parted the hind legs of his milch camel; i. e., made an opening, or intervening space, between them; (S, O, K;) in order that he might milk her. (S, O.) ＝
-A2- افحج also signifies He refrained, or desisted, or drew back; syn. أَحْجَمَ. (O, K.) And one says, افحج عَنْهُ, meaning He turned, or turned away or back, from it, or him; syn. اِنْثَنَى. (O, * K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
